title: Self-verifiable LLM-driven science and why it needs human researchers
abstract: arXiv:2611.26754v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language models are now used throughout all sciences - for reading literature, extracting numbers from tables and spectra, analyzing data, drafting conclusions - and their answers arrive in the same polished confident tone whether they are right or wrong, so a result has to be re-derived by a human researcher before it can be relied on. The cost of that re-checking, not the ability to generate results, is what currently limits AI-assisted research. In the field of mathematics, this problem is solved by proof assistants like Lean 4 and Coq that let any formal statement and its proof be written down and checked - a perfect match for LLMs, which are now actively used to search for proofs with every step automatically validated, rather than relying on a human to judge the result. In this paper, we propose an extension of this approach to non-mathematical sciences. We describe an AI agent harness that aims to make LLM's scientific reasoning

translated_title: 自验证的LLM驱动科学，以及它为何仍需要人类研究者
translated_abstract: 语言模型如今已广泛应用于所有科学领域——用于阅读文献、从表格和光谱中提取数值、分析数据、起草结论——然而无论答案正确与否，它们都以同样精致自信的语气呈现，因此研究结果必须由人类研究者重新推导验证之后才能被信赖。目前限制AI辅助科研发展的，正是这种人工复核的成本，而非生成结果的能力。在数学领域，这一问题已通过Lean 4和Coq等证明助手得到解决：任何形式化的命题及其证明都可以被写下来并自动检验——这与大语言模型堪称完美契合，如今LLM已被积极用于搜索证明，每一步都经过自动验证，而无需依赖人类来判断结果的对错。在本文中，我们提出将这一方法扩展到非数学科学领域。我们描述了一种AI智能体框架，旨在使LLM的科学推理……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出把数学领域中形式化证明自动验证的思路（如Lean 4、Coq）推广到非数学科学，设计一种能让LLM科学推理实现自我验证的AI智能体框架，从而把AI辅助科研的瓶颈从“生成结果”转移到消除人工复核成本上。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes extending the self-verifying formal proof paradigm of mathematics (e.g., Lean 4 and Coq) to non-mathematical sciences via an AI agent harness that makes LLM-driven scientific reasoning automatically verifiable, addressing the human re-checking cost that currently limits AI-assisted research.
